author: jaffar21
install_msg: Thanks for installing F1 Driver Guess! Run `[p]f1drivers setup` once as admin to download all driver portraits. Then use `[p]f1drivers start` to play!
short: Guess the F1 driver from their photo — first to 10 points wins.
description: A picture-based Formula 1 trivia game. The bot posts a photo of a driver and the first person to type the correct name wins the point. Accepts first names, last names, full names, and nicknames. Run [p]f1drivers setup once to cache all images locally for instant, reliable delivery. First to 10 points wins.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
